Research
Welcome to our research pages!
The Department of Chemistry brings together around 200 researchers within analytical, physical, materials, inorganic, and organic and structural chemistry to address sustainability challenges in energy, the environment and health. Close collaboration with academia, industry and the society, supported by world-class research infrastructure, enables both internal and external researchers to achieve high-quality scientific results, practical solutions and patents.

We are located in the Arrhenius Laboratory at the Frescati campus.
SUCCeSS
An interdisciplinary meeting place for researchers at Stockholm University working on sustainability and circular systems.
Wise
Sweden’s largest initiative in materials science for a sustainable future, funded by the Knut and Alice Wallenberg Foundation.
SwedNMR
A national research infrastructure funded by VR-RFI and nine universities, providing state-of-the-art NMR instrumentation and expert support.
ARTEMI
Sweden's national infrastructure for advanced Electron Microscopy funded by VR-RFI and SSF, and comprising seven universities.
